reviewer: Claude coordinator and independent Claude review agents (text, illustrations)
text: Independent review agent read the full text against Ryder's The Credulous Fiend (Book V); every beat is told in full: the corner reveal, the horse disguise, the thief's ride and the bit that will not stop the horse, the banyan escape, the monkey's call, the tail bite and the fiend's 'Twilight' verdict.

Ryder's set-up is kept after review: the fiend seizes and torments the princess each evening and her circle stops him only from carrying her off; worded with nothing sexual, and the contentNote says so plainly.
The Twilight pun is rebuilt in Kannada as ಮುಸ್ಸಂಜೆಯ ಕಾಟ, read like ಭೂತದ ಕಾಟ, so the fiend's mistake is believable.

The ending stays open as in Ryder (an added 'never returned to the palace' line was removed in review); the names, omitted frame and small closing details are disclosed. Age 8+: the fiend is comic and nobody dies or is badly hurt.
illustrations: Storyboard 1024x1536, 428 KB; seams exactly at 512 and 1024; painted to every edge, no text or gutters.
The comic fiend, the fiend-horse, the thief and the monkey stay consistent across all six panels; no injury or blood is drawn.

After review, a single-panel edit redrew panel 6 so the thief hangs by both hands while biting the monkey's tail, the tail continuous from the monkey; a stray reddish dot under the princess's hairline in panel 1 was retouched by hand.
The credit line truthfully records one generation, a rejected full-sheet edit, the panel 6 edit, the hand retouch and uniform rescaling onto the grid.
limitations: AI-agent editorial review, not human Kannada-teacher or scholar certification.
Age bands are editorial judgements against the README table and have not been tested with children, parents or adult readers.
Source fidelity was checked against saved copies of the Wikisource pages of Ryder's 1925 translation, not against Durgasimha's Kannada text or a Sanskrit recension.
Art was generated with Codex CLI on gpt-5.6-sol and judged on the full sheet and 512px panel crops with the grid measured in pixels; edited panels were re-checked by the same independent agent.
